meta.guide_tau: Level caption:  energy (NIST, or a measurement of the last 20 years where one exists) and measured lifetime (where one exists).
meta.notes: Conventions. (1) Isotope-shift keys 'a-b' mean nu(a) - nu(b), all relative to 64Zn as printed; 67Zn values are hyperfine centres of gravity. (2) Fields beyond SCHEMA.md: natural_linewidth_*, photoionization, top-level 'rydberg' (ionization limit) and 'conflicts'. (3) rme_J_ea0 values are derived here from lifetimes (schema convention, branching to the ground state taken as 1); the 307.6 nm one rests on an approximate, uncited lifetime. (4) The 307.6 nm frequency_THz is a natural-mixture Doppler centre and is flagged 'not verified' in its source string so that the pipeline ignores it. (5) Zinc has far less modern laser-spectroscopy data than Cd or Hg: only the two ground-state lines have been measured with lasers. (6) Added 2026-10-01 (second pass): lifetimes of the 4sns 3S1 (n = 5-8) and 4snd 3D (n = 4-7) levels (Kerkhoff et al. 1980 read directly in the Springer two-page preview; Blagoev et al. 2004 second-hand from Kurucz's life3000.lab), 67Zn hyperfine constants of 4s4p 3P2 and 4s5s 3S1, isotope shifts of the 481.2 nm line relative to 68Zn (keys 'A-68' = nu(A) - nu(68), unc = statistical error only), and lifetime-normalised A values of the 3P-3S1 and 3P-3D multiplets (LS-coupling branching, see the notes). NIST lists 4s7d 3D1 and 3D2 at the same energy 72626.0 cm^-1: the entries are told apart by J only.
